definition_zh: 勤勉；刻苦；专心致志；殷勤
definition_en: constant and careful attention to work or duty; persistent diligence
core_image: 书桌前一坐数小时、笔不离手的学者
scene: 他的论文写在无数个清晨与深夜，靠的是日复一日的苦功。Her assiduity in the lab earned the team its first patent.
sceneCN: 这里 assiduity 是「勤勉、专注」（第 1 个义项：对工作持续用心的品质）；句意是她在实验室的勤勉为团队赢得首项专利。

derivatives.zh: 同根形容词，义为「勤勉的；专注的」
由形容词加副词后缀构成，义为「勤勉地」
同源近形词（拉丁语 obsianus），义为「黑曜石」

senses.title: Persistent diligence
senses.definition: steady, careful, and unrelenting effort at a task
senses.definitionCN: 对任务持续、细致、不懈的努力
senses.example: Translation of this quality demands years of assiduity.
senses.exampleCN: 这种水准的翻译需要多年的潜心苦功。
senses.why: Latin assiduus meant seated at a task: diligence as literally staying seated with the work.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 assiduus 意为「坐在工作上」：勤勉即字面地与工作同席不离。

senses.title: Attentive care toward someone
senses.definition: constant, attentive attention paid to a person
senses.definitionCN: 对某人持续的细心照料
senses.example: The old butler's assiduities made guests feel royal.
senses.exampleCN: 老管家的殷勤周到令客人如沐皇恩。
senses.why: Staying seated beside a person becomes staying close in care.
senses.whyCN: 「坐在身旁不离」化作照料中的常伴左右。

intro.en: Assiduity comes from Latin assiduitas, from assiduus, constant, literally sitting beside, from assidere.
intro.cn: assiduity 源自拉丁语 assiduitas，出自 assiduus（持续的，字面为「坐在旁侧」），来自 assidere。

items.en: Assidere meant to sit beside or attend.
items.cn: 拉丁语 assidere 意为坐在旁侧、侍奉。

items.en: Assiduus meant constant, devoted; Roman legal texts also played on a supposed link with as, a coin, for paying attention.
items.cn: assiduus 意为持续、专注；罗马法律文本还曾与意为铜币的 as 玩双关。

items.en: Assiduitas was the quality of such constancy.
items.cn: assiduitas 指这种持续性的品质。

items.en: English took both assiduous and assiduity in the sixteenth century.
items.cn: 十六世纪英语同时借入 assiduous 与 assiduity。

note.en: Assiduity is diligence with an image: staying seated at the task until it is done.
note.cn: assiduity 的勤勉带着画面：坐在任务前寸步不离，直到完成。

entries.definition: diligent, from the same sitting root via Latin
entries.definitionCN: 勤奋的（同出「坐」词根的近义词）

entries.definition: similar ending, different Latin root entirely
entries.definitionCN: 焦虑（后缀相似，词源不同）

normalIntro.cn: 「额西丢」→联想「额习读」：额日日习读不辍，就是 assiduity（勤勉）。

normal.en: assiduous is the adjective; assiduity the noun.
normal.cn: assiduous 为形容词，assiduity 为名词。

normal.en: plural assiduities can mean attentions paid to a person.
normal.cn: 复数 assiduities 可指对人的殷勤照料。

normal.en: sedulous is its synonym from the same sitting idea.
normal.cn: sedulous 同出「坐」意象，是它的近义词。

normal.en: Roman pun linked it to paying with coins.
normal.cn: 罗马人曾以「付铜币」双关联想到专注。

abstract.en: Picture worn grooves on a scholar's desk edge.
abstract.cn: 想象学者桌沿被岁月磨出的凹痕。

abstract.en: See the same chair occupied at dawn and midnight.
abstract.cn: 看见清晨与午夜坐着的同一把椅子。

abstract.en: Feel a nurse's unhurried rounds at midnight.
abstract.cn: 体会护士午夜查房的不疾不徐。

examples.en: His assiduity finally cracked the cipher.
examples.cn: 他的苦功终于破解了密码。

examples.en: The biographer worked with minute assiduity.
examples.cn: 传记作者以一丝不苟的勤勉写作。

examples.en: Guests remember the staff's quiet assiduities.
examples.cn: 客人仍记得员工无声的殷勤照料。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「额西丢体」——额把西窗书读透、笔耕不辍强身体，正是 assiduity 的勤勉。

root: 拉丁语 assidere（坐在旁侧）→ assiduus（不离其位的、持续的）→ assiduitas（勤勉），核心意象是「与工作同席」。

sensesIntro.en: Staying seated at the task becomes both tireless work and tender attendance.
sensesIntro.cn: 「不离席位」既化作不倦的工作，也化作贴身的照料。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a chair never left until the work is done
core.cn: 核心意象：工作未成、不离座椅

branches.en: unbroken presence beside the task or person
branches.cn: 与任务或人形影不离的陪伴

intro.en: The sitting root links diligence with presence: to work is to stay.
intro.cn: 「坐」词根把勤勉与在场相连：工作即留守。

latinIntro.en: Latin assidere and assiduus anchor this family of steadfastness.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 assidere 与 assiduus 是这一「坚守」词族的锚点。

items.meaning: to value highly, hence work carefully
